limitations: The theorem does not show that every such operator is a single commutator. Because the proof is short and uses classical shift identities, an equivalent observation under older terminology remains a residual priority risk.
record_title: Two-commutator transfer for self-similar factorization ideals
scientific_context: If a Banach space \(Y\) is isomorphic to a countable \(\ell_p\)- or \(c_0\)-sum of itself and is complemented in \(X\), then every operator on \(X\) that factors through \(Y\) is a sum of two commutators whose four factors all factor through \(Y\); in particular this lowers the cited three-commutator bounds for the James-space and related factorization ideals to two.
